stops.name: Bad Gastein
stops.quote: Bad Gastein impresses with its Belle Époque architecture and roaring waterfalls.
stops.english: Bad Gastein impresses with its Belle Époque architecture and roaring waterfalls.

stops.name: Bad Hofgastein
stops.quote: Bad Hofgastein offers family-friendly trails, bike parks and small mountain lakes.
stops.english: Bad Hofgastein offers family-friendly trails, bike parks and small mountain lakes.

stops.name: Dorfgastein
stops.quote: Around Dorfgastein, you’ll find quiet Alpine paths, historic mills and regional cuisine.
stops.english: Around Dorfgastein, you’ll find quiet Alpine paths, historic mills and regional cuisine.

stops.name: Felsentherme
stops.quote: At the Felsentherme in Bad Gastein you bathe in it inside the rock itself, across four separate spa areas, with the surrounding mountains in view.
stops.english: At the Felsentherme in Bad Gastein you bathe in it inside the rock itself, across four separate spa areas, with the surrounding mountains in view.

stops.name: Alpentherme
stops.quote: The Alpentherme in Bad Hofgastein has water areas, saunas and quiet rooms.
stops.english: The Alpentherme in Bad Hofgastein has water areas, saunas and quiet rooms.

stops.name: Gadaunerer Gorge
stops.quote: Many of them can be visited – the Gadaunerer Gorge, the Entrische Kirche show cave, the glacial mills above Bad Gastein.
stops.english: Many of them can be visited – the Gadaunerer Gorge, the Entrische Kirche show cave, the glacial mills above Bad Gastein.

stops.name: Entrische Kirche
stops.quote: Many of them can be visited – the Gadaunerer Gorge, the Entrische Kirche show cave, the glacial mills above Bad Gastein.
stops.english: Many of them can be visited – the Gadaunerer Gorge, the Entrische Kirche show cave, the glacial mills above Bad Gastein.

stops.name: Gastein Healing Gallery (Heilstollen)
stops.quote: The water is used at the Felsentherme in Bad Gastein, the Alpentherme in Bad Hofgastein and the Gastein Healing Gallery (Heilstollen).
stops.english: The water is used at the Felsentherme in Bad Gastein, the Alpentherme in Bad Hofgastein and the Gastein Healing Gallery (Heilstollen).

stops.name: Gamskarkogel
stops.quote: The highest peak in the area is the Ankogel (3,252 m), while within the valley the Gamskarkogel (2,467 m) dominates the landscape.
stops.english: The highest peak in the area is the Ankogel (3,252 m), while within the valley the Gamskarkogel (2,467 m) dominates the landscape.
